chunks: Abu Ali Al-Ash'ari, from Muhammad ibn Abd al-Jabbar, from Safwan ibn Yahya, from Ibn Muskan, from Abu Bakr Al-Hadrami, who said:

I said to Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him): A man married a woman, then he went to a land and married her sister, while he did not know. He (peace be upon him) said: He keeps whichever of the two he wishes, and he releases the other one.
ai.seo_question: What is the ruling if a man marries two sisters at the same time without knowing they are sisters?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Kafi clarifies the ruling for 'gharar' (uncertainty) in marriage, where a man unknowingly marries two sisters. The Imam's decision to allow him to retain one and release the other reflects the principle of preserving the validity of the first contract while avoiding the complexity of dissolving both, a key distinction in Shia fiqh from the Sunni view which often requires divorcing both. This ruling underscores the practical application of avoiding prohibited degrees of kinship when knowledge is lacking.
